newsitem.title: USA: Amcore to take Q2 charge for acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Amcore to take Q2 charge for acquisition.

text.p: Amcore Financial Inc said Friday it will record an after-tax charge of about $1.3 million, or $0.08 per share, in the second quarter for expenses related to its acquisition of First National Bancorp of Monroe, Wis.

In late October Amcore said it reached a definitive agreement to acquire First National Bancorp. It said First National holders would receive 7.54 shares of Amcore common for each of the approximately 250,000 outstanding First Bancorp shares outstanding.

In completing its acquisition of the $215 million assets First National Bancorp, Amcore preident Robert Meuleman said it "is now a multi-state financial institution. We are no longer just an Illinois institution."
First National, which has five offices in southern Wisconsin, will become Amcore's sixth subsidiary bank, operating as Amcore Bank N.A., South Central.
